home_description: This is a demo of paraglide-js internationalization.
recording_recorder_error_unsupported: Audio recording is not supported in this environment.
recording_recorder_error_empty_capture: No audio was captured. Please try again.
recording_recorder_error_save_failed: Could not save the recording. Please try again.
topic_error_empty_title: A topic needs a title. Press Esc to restore the previous one.
topic_error_too_long: This title is too long. Shorten it to 2000 characters or fewer.
link_youtube_player_unavailable: Could not load the player. Click to retry or open the link.
folder_view_empty_hint: Drop cards onto this folder to collect them.
toast_export_no_notes: Select notes, or a group or folder containing notes, to export.
toast_export_unsaved: Save or resolve the pending note changes before exporting.
toast_markdown_export_partial: Exported {count} notes; {failed} failed. Check the failure list in index.md before sharing.
settings_workspace_export_help: Note bodies are stored as structured JSON in the workspace. Use the canvas export menu to create Markdown for all notes, this canvas, or a selection; referenced attachments are copied with it. Use a workspace ZIP for a complete backup, including the original JSON records. Canvas JSON includes a Markdown representation of note bodies for compatibility.
empty_canvas_description: Add a note, open your library, or start from a reusable canvas template.
empty_canvas_hint_drop: Drop files anywhere to add them
canvas_type_productivity_checklist_descr: A checklist you can tick off on the canvas.
canvas_type_productivity_pomodoro_descri: Focus timer with short and long breaks.
canvas_type_productivity_reminder_descri: A dated reminder with optional repeat.
canvas_type_media_image_description: An image attached to this workspace.
canvas_type_media_file_description: A file attachment on the canvas.
canvas_type_media_recording_description: A voice memo recorded on the canvas.
delete_tag_confirm_body: "{tag}" will be removed from every note in this workspace.
toast_no_placement_slot: No space available to place the new node
toast_topic_container_gone: The group this topic belongs to no longer exists.
toast_topic_container_locked: The group this topic belongs to is locked.
toast_topic_relation_unavailable: The topic this one attaches to is no longer available.
toast_topic_layout_locked: This change would move a locked topic, so nothing was changed.
toast_topic_layout_overlap: This branch overlaps nearby content. You can tidy the branch or move the tree.
toast_topic_layout_group_full: Not enough space in the group. Enlarge the group or move the whole tree.
toast_topic_branch_locked: This branch contains a locked topic, so nothing was deleted.
toast_topic_tree_frozen: This tree has broken relations. Repair it before changing its structure.
toast_locked_nodes_not_deleted: Locked items can't be deleted, so they were skipped.
toast_undo_failed: Could not undo the latest change
toast_redo_failed: Could not redo the latest change
toast_view_switch_save_failed: Could not save the current canvas — switch canceled.
toast_canvas_not_ready: Canvas is not ready to export yet.
toast_asset_file_unsaved: File has not been saved yet.
toast_asset_file_open_blocked: GhostBoard won't open executable or script files directly. Use “Reveal in Finder” if you trust this file.
folder_edit_description: Update the folder's name and description.
delete_folder_confirm_body: Only the folder shell will be removed. Notes and images inside will not be deleted; they will become ungrouped content in Note Library.
replace_image_confirm_body: The current image will be replaced with the new one. This action can be undone.
delete_view_confirm_body: "{name}" and everything on it will be moved to trash. You can undo this from the toast that appears next.
view_rename_too_long: Names must be 80 characters or fewer.
view_rename_duplicate: Another canvas already uses this name.
toast_canvas_save_conflict: Canvas could not be saved because note versions conflict. Your local changes are kept; open the affected notes to review them before switching canvases.
toast_canvas_save_failed: Canvas could not be saved. Your local changes are kept. Check workspace access and try again before closing the app.
note_conflict_description: Your draft is still here. Compare the versions, then choose which one to keep.
note_conflict_load_error: The saved version could not be loaded. Your draft is unchanged.
note_conflict_close_warning: Your unresolved draft will be lost if you close this note. Close anyway?
toast_save_failed: Could not save this note. We'll retry on your next edit.
library_detached_toast: This note is not placed on the canvas yet.
template_quick_start_description: Get to know GhostBoard in 5 minutes — pan, zoom, focus, connect, and stack, all on one canvas.
template_blank_description: An empty canvas. Build your knowledge graph from scratch.
template_weekly_planner_description: Seven Mon-to-Sun lanes with a checklist per day, plus a weekly goal and review card.
template_kanban_description: A simple Kanban board with To Do, In Progress, and Done lanes — perfect for project tracking.
template_sprint_retro_description: Four-quadrant retrospective board: Went well, Improve, Action items, and Shoutouts.
template_brainstorm_mindmap_description: Topic in the middle, one branch per section, evidence hanging off each. Get the bones right before you write.
template_eisenhower_matrix_description: Sort tasks by urgency × importance: Do, Schedule, Delegate, or Drop.
template_reading_notes_description: Arguments, highlights, chapter notes and a review draft side by side. Finish the book, start writing.
template_demo_description: A showcase canvas demonstrating GhostBoard's primitives: cards, checklists, folders, sticky notes, and groups.
template_cafe_description: A shop-planning canvas: mind map, notes, stickies, a folder, a checklist, photos, and a link.
template_novel_bible_description: Premise, characters, timeline, foreshadowing and places on one board, so chapter ten still adds up.
template_interview_notes_description: Who you talked to, quotable lines, a timeline, a fact-check list and the transcript split into sections.
template_topic_pool_description: Ideas, in progress, published: three columns plus a short test for picking what to write next.
template_feature_story_description: A feature from pitch to draft: sources, interviews and quotes on the left, the draft on the right, exported as Markdown.
canvas_bg_picker_description: Pick a color or add your own
settings_ai_description: Configure the language model that powers AI features in the BlockNote editor.
settings_ai_base_url_hint: Use the API base URL, not a chat/completions endpoint. Leave blank for the official OpenAI/Anthropic endpoint.
settings_ai_reload_hint: Changes apply to open notes after saving. Each provider keeps its own model, API address and key.
settings_workspace_restart_required: Restart GhostBoard for the new workspace to take effect.
settings_canvas_types_description: Enable or disable built-in canvas types for this workspace. Disabling a type keeps existing instances.
settings_canvas_types_empty: No canvas types are registered in this build.
settings_canvas_types_clear_confirm: Delete {count} saved {name} instances? Canvas nodes stay in place and show a fallback until you recreate them.
settings_canvas_types_clear_failed: Could not clear canvas type data.
settings_plugins_description: Install plugins for this application; choose which to enable in this workspace.
settings_plugins_runtime_notice: Enabled commands and panels run in the trusted host page. Signed updates, code rollback, migration backups, and startup safe mode are available. See the plugin menu for runtime status, errors, and reload controls.
settings_plugins_safe_mode_description: Third-party plugin code was skipped before loading. Plugin management remains available so you can disable a faulty plugin without changing its data.
settings_plugins_safe_mode_previous_star: GhostBoard entered safe mode automatically because the previous plugin startup did not finish.
settings_plugins_safe_mode_damaged_state: GhostBoard could not trust the saved plugin startup state, preserved the damaged file, and failed closed.
settings_plugins_safe_mode_explicit: Safe mode was requested with --safe-mode or GHOSTBOARD_SAFE_MODE=1.
settings_plugins_safe_mode_try_next_laun: Try enabled plugins on next launch
settings_plugins_safe_mode_next_launch_r: The next launch will try enabled plugins. This session remains in safe mode.
settings_plugins_preview_description: GhostBoard checked this archive without executing its code. Review it before installing for this application. Installation does not enable it.
settings_plugins_stored: Installed, not enabled in this workspace
settings_plugins_enable_review_descripti: Plugins run with high trust and may access workspace data, local files, the network, and the host page. Capabilities are author claims, not restrictions. Enable only code you trust.
settings_plugins_invalid: Package files no longer pass validation. Reinstall this package before it can be used.
settings_plugins_unavailable: Plugin management is unavailable outside the desktop app.
settings_cleanup_description: Workspace content files that are not referenced by any canvas (including trashed canvases).
settings_cleanup_unscanned: Click Scan to find unlinked files.
settings_cleanup_empty: All files are linked. Nothing to clean up.
settings_cleanup_delete_failed_one: 1 file could not be moved to Trash.
settings_cleanup_delete_failed_other: {count} files could not be moved to Trash.
settings_cleanup_confirm_body_one: 1 file will be moved to the system Trash. You can restore it from the Trash.
settings_cleanup_confirm_body_other: {count} files will be moved to the system Trash. You can restore them from the Trash.
settings_trash_clear_all_confirm_body_on: 1 canvas will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings_trash_clear_all_confirm_body_ot: {count} canvases will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings_purge_confirm_body: "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings_shortcut_description: Cheatsheet of every shortcut available on the canvas. Use ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl on Windows/Linux.
settings_about_update_available: Update available — version {version} is ready to install.
settings_about_update_no_update: You are on the latest version.
settings_about_dev_channel_note: Updates are disabled on the dev channel. Use a release build to receive automatic updates.
ai_error_disabled: AI is not enabled. Add a provider and API key in Settings.
ai_error_empty_selection: Select at least one card or sticky with content first.
ai_error_model: Model or API endpoint not found. Check the model ID and base URL.
ai_error_rpc: Could not reach the app backend. Restart the app and try again.
ai_error_unsupported: This AI task is not available yet.
toast_ai_card_added: AI summary added — press ⌘Z to undo
settings_plugins_permissions_description: Revoke remembered access at any time. Revoking file access also closes current file handles. A different author key or reconnected development source must ask again. Plugins still run in the trusted host page; these controls do not isolate malicious code.
settings_plugins_remove_warning: Disable this plugin in every workspace and revoke its file and delete permissions? Installed code is archived. Your notes, cards, attachments, plugin storage, and development source files are kept. Reinstall or reconnect to use it again.
settings_plugins_remove_success: Plugin removed. Your content has been kept.
settings_plugins_no_capabilities: No capabilities declared; this does not restrict access.
settings_plugins_signature_unsigned: Unsigned package. It can be used locally but cannot update this plugin ID in place.
settings_plugins_signature_verified: The package signature is valid for its supplied key. First installation trusts and pins that key and update source; this does not verify the author's identity or code safety.
settings_plugins_update_found: Verified update {version} is ready for review.
settings_plugins_rollback_success: Rolled back to {version}. The plugin remains disabled until you review and enable it.
settings_plugins_migration_restore_warni: This disables the plugin and replaces migrated instance data with the latest pre-migration copies. Changes made after migration may be lost. A guard copy of the current data is retained on disk.
settings_plugins_migration_restore_succe: Restored {count} instance data backup. The plugin remains disabled.
settings_plugins_legacy: Legacy contract; reinstall a v2 version.
settings_plugins_development_notice: Choose a directory containing manifest.json and app.js. Changes reload automatically while enabled. Repeated reloads can retain old module closures; reload the window when needed.
settings_plugins_directory_preview: This only registers the directory, without copying or executing code. Once enabled, code changes in this directory load automatically without another confirmation.
toast_topic_outline_blocked: Cannot export the topic outline because this canvas has broken topic relations or an unsupported topic version. Use a lossless backup if you need the original data.
toast_topic_write_paused: This canvas has topic records that cannot be saved safely. Edits stay in memory and the original file is not overwritten.
toast_node_quota: Free version limited to 100 cards. Please activate a license to continue.
ai_test_success: Connected. Streaming and tool calling are supported.
ai_test_hint: Sends a small test request to the selected model. Save your key first.
ai_review_hint: AI changes are not saved until you accept them. Closing the note discards unaccepted changes.
ai_error_configuration: Check the model, API key and HTTP(S) API base URL in AI settings.
ai_error_authentication: Authentication failed. Check the API key for this provider.
ai_error_rate_limit: Rate limit or quota reached. Check your provider account or try later.
ai_error_unsupported_tools: This model or endpoint could not complete the required tool call. Choose a model that supports tools.
ai_error_timeout: The request timed out. Try again or choose a faster model.
ai_error_cancelled: Generation stopped. Review the partial result or discard it.
ai_error_network: Could not connect. Check the API address, network or local model service.
ai_error_unknown: AI request failed. Test the connection in AI settings, then retry.
ai_key_environment: Using an environment variable. Clearing the saved key does not remove the environment key.
settings_feedback_description: Tell us what went wrong or what you would like to see in GhostBoard.
settings_feedback_placeholder: What happened? What did you expect? Steps to reproduce help us investigate.
settings_feedback_email_placeholder: For a reply about your feedback
settings_feedback_logs_description: Includes recent application errors and version / system information. Common credentials, email addresses and local paths are filtered. You can preview the logs before sending; avoid sharing private information in your feedback.
settings_feedback_success: Thank you! Your feedback was received. Reference: {id}
settings_feedback_error_unavailable: Feedback is available in the desktop app.
settings_feedback_error_not_configured: The feedback service is not configured for this build.
settings_feedback_error_network: Could not connect. Your feedback is still here; please try again.
settings_feedback_error_rate_limited: Too many reports. Please try again later.
settings_feedback_error_invalid: Check your message and email, then try again.
settings_feedback_error_server: The feedback service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
settings_feedback_auto_upload_descriptio: Sends error details and recent logs to help diagnose crashes. Unexpected exits are reported on the next launch and may include forced quits or power loss. Failed uploads retry while the app is running. Turning this off clears pending reports.
settings_feedback_diagnostics_error: Could not load or save diagnostic settings. Please try again.
learning_daily_enabled: Automatically show one tip each day
learning_shortcuts_hint: These shortcuts work on the canvas. While typing, your editor keeps its own shortcuts.
learning_return_hint: You can replay this guide or find all shortcuts from Help in the bottom-left toolbar.
learning_move_description: Hold Space, then drag to move the canvas. Dragging empty space without Space selects cards. Release Space to return to selection.
learning_create_description: Open the create menu and choose Note. Select a note card and press Enter, or double-click it, to start editing. Your changes save automatically.
learning_find_description: Search for notes, files and canvases. Use the arrow keys to move between cards, and Esc to close an open note and return to the canvas.
learning_organize_description: Drag a selection box on empty space to select several cards, then group them. Duplicate useful cards, and undo if an action goes wrong.
settings_shortcut_scroll_pan: Pan with a mouse or trackpad
tip_pan_description: Hold Space while dragging to pan. Release it to select cards again. Scrolling or swiping with two fingers also moves the canvas.
tip_create_title: Your next idea is one shortcut away
tip_create_description: Open the create menu to add a note, sticky, file or another card. You can also use the + button in the bottom bar.
tip_search_description: Search finds notes, files and canvases. On the canvas, you can also start typing to open search with that text.
tip_open_title: Enter to open, Esc to return
tip_open_description: Select a note card and press Enter to edit it. Press Esc to return to the canvas. Double-clicking a note opens it too.
tip_select_title: Select several cards in one gesture
tip_select_description: Drag on empty canvas to draw a selection box. To move the canvas instead, hold Space before dragging.
tip_undo_title: A mistake is easy to undo
tip_undo_description: Undo your last canvas action. Add Shift to the undo shortcut to redo it. While editing a note, undo applies to the note's text.
tip_group_description: Select several cards and group them. Add Shift to the group shortcut to ungroup a selected group.
tip_duplicate_title: Build on a card you already have
tip_duplicate_description: Select a card and duplicate it to reuse its content without changing the original. This works with several selected cards too.
tip_zoom_description: Reset zoom to 100%. Use the + and − zoom shortcuts to zoom in and out, or pinch with two fingers on a trackpad.
tip_files_title: Bring your files onto the canvas
tip_files_description: Drag files from your file manager onto the canvas. Images, PDFs, audio and other supported files become cards you can arrange beside your notes.
tip_library_title: Your notes also live in the library
tip_library_description: Open Note Library from the bottom-left toolbar to browse workspace notes, including notes that are not on the current canvas.
tip_navigate_title: Move between cards with the keyboard
tip_navigate_description: Arrow keys select nearby cards in that direction. Hold Shift while pressing an arrow to add to the selection. Press Enter to open a selected note.
license_dialog_description: Enter your license key to unlock unlimited cards and premium features.
asset_save_failed_workspace: Failed to save "{fileName}" to the workspace. Is GhostBoard connected to a workspace?
toast_canvas_json_empty: Canvas JSON did not contain importable nodes.
toast_canvas_json_widgets_skipped: Skipped {count} widget(s) that could not be imported.
toast_canvas_json_import_failed: Canvas JSON could not be imported.
toast_clone_canvas_type_failed: Failed to clone a canvas type; the copy was skipped.
toast_clone_widget_failed: Failed to clone a widget; the copy was skipped.
template_thumbnail_empty: The canvas is empty; cannot generate a thumbnail
template_thumbnail_rpc_unavailable: RPC unavailable (make sure Electrobun is running)
library_all_on_canvas: All notes are on the canvas.
extension_fallback_corrupted: This instance could not be loaded. The original file is kept.
extension_fallback_incompatible: This card needs a compatible plugin migration. The original data is kept.
extension_fallback_disabled: This canvas type is disabled in the current workspace.
extension_fallback_unavailable: This canvas type is unavailable. Data is kept.
asset_media_load_failed: Media file could not be loaded.
toast_move_target_load_failed: Could not read the target canvas — nothing was moved.
toast_move_canvas_changed: The canvas changed during the move — nothing was moved.
toast_canvas_recovered_from_backup: This canvas could not be read and was restored from a backup ({source}). Recent changes may be missing.
toast_view_delete_save_failed: Could not save the current canvas — deletion canceled.
canvas_load_error_readonly: Canvas failed to load. Edits will not be saved.
canvas_load_error_corrupt: The canvas file is damaged and has not been opened or restored. The original file has not been overwritten. Retry to check for a backup, or use the recovery tools below.
canvas_load_error_missing: This canvas could not be found.
canvas_load_error_failed: An error occurred while reading this canvas: {message}
canvas_pending_recovery_confirm: Unsaved canvas backup from {source}, saved {time}. {status} Restore this backup in place of the loaded canvas? Cancel keeps the disk version. A recovery copy will be retained.
canvas_recovery_base_matches: The disk graph matches the version this backup was based on.
canvas_recovery_base_unknown: The disk version changed or cannot be verified; the backup may be older.
canvas_disk_recovery_confirm: This canvas is damaged. Open the backup from {source} and allow saving the recovered canvas? Recent changes may be missing. Cancel keeps this canvas closed and preserves the files.
recovery_description: Review saved copies before restoring. Restore creates a separate canvas; existing canvases and note contents are preserved. Referenced notes and widgets use their current contents.
recovery_failed: The operation failed or the source changed. Refresh and try again.
recovery_other_workspace: This copy belongs to another workspace. Open that workspace to restore it, or export the copy.
recovery_no_comparison: The original cannot be compared. Review the backup before restoring as a new canvas.
recovery_difference: Compared with disk: {added} added, {removed} removed, {changed} changed nodes.
recovery_invalid: This copy is incomplete or damaged. Export the original data for inspection; direct restore is disabled.
recovery_created: A separate canvas was created. Select it from the canvas list to inspect it. The backup was retained.
toast_folder_connected_nodes: Disconnect all selected nodes before moving them into a folder. No nodes or connections were removed.
toast_folder_selection_rejected: The selection includes a locked or unsupported node. Nothing was moved into the folder.
transaction_recovery_description: Writes are paused to protect your files. Retry recovery, or export the evidence before choosing to keep current files.
transaction_recovery_done: Recovery completed. You can retry saving.
transaction_recovery_quarantine_warning: This keeps current files and archives the interrupted transaction with its original versions. A partially completed save may remain; review your content after continuing.
transaction_recovery_archived: Evidence retained at {file}. Current files were preserved; writes are available again.
toast_canvas_layout_saved_conflict: Layout saved. Some notes conflict with newer saved versions. Use saved notes to replace only conflicting local drafts; a recovery copy will be retained.
toast_clone_cleanup_retained: Some unused copies could not be reclaimed. Their files were retained safely; retry cleanup when the workspace is available.
canvas_isolated_records: Isolated {count} invalid canvas records. The original file was preserved. Review Canvas data diagnostics in Workspace settings before saving the remaining valid content.
toast_rpc_invalid_params: Could not complete {method}: invalid request data. Nothing was written.
toast_rpc_timeout: The operation timed out and may still be completing. Check the result before retrying.
data_diagnostics_description: Invalid records are isolated for display, and the original bytes are preserved. File cleanup stays blocked until damaged references are repaired or a damaged deleted canvas is archived.
data_diagnostics_active: Open this canvas to review valid content, then save it or recover a backup. The damaged original is retained alongside the file.
data_diagnostics_warning: Remove this damaged canvas from Deleted Canvases and retain its original file in the recovery directory? Its notes and attachments remain. They may appear as unlinked files in a future manual cleanup.
data_diagnostics_confirm: Archive and remove from Deleted Canvases
data_diagnostics_done: Damaged deleted canvas archived. Retry the file cleanup scan.
